name: moa-ams-workspace
description: Ethiopian Ministry of Agriculture - Fixed Asset Tracking System (MoA-ATS) Mobile-First PWA & Express API

scripts.docker:local: docker compose -p moa-ams-local -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d --build
scripts.docker:local:down: docker compose -p moa-ams-local -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml down
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.test:unit: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend

author: Ministry of Agriculture, Ethiopia
